preserved: norms.json,cofactors.json,P192-blocks.json,P192-cofactors.json and their original source publication remain unchanged
new_control: independently check every toy norm-decoded point by baby/giant transfer from public delta=G-Q and U, retaining the corresponding multiples of G; never consume the scalar label
record: optional --transfer-check keeps output JSON identical and reports exact check calls and giant lookups to stderr
cost_boundary: generic table transfer is O(sqrt(r)) point work and memory with reusable table; the norm candidate enumerates r factors; no timing or speedup claim
P192: selected block check unchanged; no full P192 table search
